state.emptyFull: None of the changed files declare a function, method, or class this repo's index tracks.
state.emptyLowConfidence: Nothing was found, but the index has low confidence (some imports could not be resolved), so impacted code may be missing.
state.noCallers: {count} changed symbol(s) — no cross-file callers found in the index.
state.reindexingBody: The graph is hidden until the new index is ready.
state.graphEmpty: No nodes to draw with the current filters.

banner.truncated: The graph was truncated to stay readable; counts are what was left out.
banner.truncatedCapped: Traversal limit reached — totals are lower bounds.
banner.partial: This repo's index is only partially built — some callers or impacted endpoints may be missing.
banner.degraded: This repo's index isn't available yet — showing a best-effort, less precise blast radius.
banner.staleOverlay: The index was built at {indexed} but the PR branches off {base}; results may differ from the real impact.
banner.staleOverlayUnknown: The index is not at the PR's base commit; results may differ from the real impact.
banner.overlayDegraded: {count, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}} could not be analysed at the PR head and fall back to base data.
banner.lowConfidence: Low-confidence index: some imports could not be resolved.
